description: Helper functions for CLI runner, including queue management, system prompt building, image handling, and argument construction.

classes.name: KeyedAsyncQueue
classes.description: A queue class for managing asynchronous tasks keyed by a string.

methods.name: enqueueCliRun
methods.description: Enqueues a task to be run with a specific key in the CLI run queue.

methods.name: resolveCliRunQueueKey
methods.description: Builds a unique key for CLI run queue based on parameters, considering Claude CLI provider specifics.

methods.name: buildSystemPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a system prompt string with runtime info, user preferences, and configuration.

methods.name: normalizeCliModel
methods.description: Normalizes a model ID based on backend aliases, trimming and case-insensitive matching.

methods.name: resolveSystemPromptUsage
methods.description: Determines whether to include a system prompt based on session state and configuration.

methods.name: resolveSessionIdToSend
methods.description: Resolves or generates a session ID for CLI communication based on backend mode.

methods.name: resolvePromptInput
methods.description: Decides whether prompt input should go to args or stdin based on backend settings.

methods.name: resolveImageExtension
methods.description: Determines file extension for an image based on MIME type.

methods.name: appendImagePathsToPrompt
methods.description: Appends image paths to a prompt string with proper formatting.

methods.name: loadPromptRefImages
methods.description: Loads images referenced in a prompt, sanitizes, and returns them.

methods.name: writeCliImages
methods.description: Writes images to temporary files, returns paths and cleanup function.

methods.name: buildCliArgs
methods.description: Constructs CLI argument list based on parameters, including model, session, prompt, and images.
